newsitem.title: THAILAND: United Parcel launches Thai service.
newsitem.headline: United Parcel launches Thai service.

text.p: United Parcel Delivery Service Ltd (UPS), a United Parcel Service of America Inc unit, announced on Wednesday the launch of its air delivery service in Thailand.
UPS said in a statement that its plane made inaugural landing here on Tuesday, making the company among the first international air express package companies to operate its own aircraft to Thailand.
UPS Thai manager Vichai Chuensuksawadi said a UPS plane would land at Bangkok's Don Muang airport every Tuesday to pick up and process Thai parcels for global distribution.
"A total of six direct weekly flights will provide service to Thailand once we are fully operational," he said.
